policies.name: Decree 08/2022 — Environmental Protection Law implementation
policies.summary: Sets producer responsibility for plastic packaging and requires phase-out of hard-to-recycle plastics in retail by 2026.

newsFeed.headline: Mekong delta plastic monitoring shows seasonal spike during monsoon
newsFeed.summary: River monitoring stations recorded plastic flows three times higher during the rainy season, mostly fragments and food packaging.

wooby.headline: Vietnam is writing new rules for plastic packaging.
wooby.narrative: Wooby loves the Gulf of Tonkin and the Mekong delta. Vietnam is starting to make companies responsible for packaging. The Mekong river still carries a lot of plastic to the sea. Wooby is hopeful but watching.
